schema.query: A natural-language question or lookup that someone searching Flask's code base might ask.
schema.expected_file: Repo-relative path of the file containing the canonical answer.
schema.expected_qualname: Within-file qualname of the symbol that answers it; empty string means a file-level location (imports / module-level).
schema.expected_lines: [start_line, end_line] of the canonical region in the source file. A chunker's chunk 'hits' the query when it is in the same file AND its own [start_line, end_line] overlaps this range.
schema.notes: Why this is the expected answer.

method: Line ranges were pulled from `data/repos/fa1df9ec-61f6-4497-ab7d-184bbc30aee5/` by grepping definitions and reading the surrounding code. A result is correct if the top-K list contains any chunk in the expected file whose line range overlaps the expected range.

queries.query: How does Flask handle an incoming WSGI request?
queries.notes: wsgi_app is the actual WSGI entry point that __call__ delegates to.

queries.query: Where is the request dispatcher that routes a request to a view function?
queries.notes: dispatch_request looks up the endpoint and invokes the view.

queries.query: How does Flask handle HTTP exceptions?
queries.notes: handle_http_exception is the dedicated HTTPException handler.

queries.query: Flask CLI command group
queries.notes: AppGroup is the click.Group subclass used by FlaskGroup. FlaskGroup also acceptable.

queries.query: Flask configuration object for app settings
queries.notes: Config(dict) is the central config class.

queries.query: Secure cookie session serialization
queries.notes: Handles signing / serializing session cookies.

queries.query: Decorator to register a URL route
queries.notes: Scaffold.route is the @app.route decorator implementation.

queries.query: Request-scoped globals like `request` and `session`
queries.notes: globals.py declares the module-level LocalProxy objects.

queries.query: Context class for an active Flask application
queries.notes: AppContext is the app context class.

queries.query: Test client for driving the app without a real server
queries.notes: FlaskClient extends werkzeug Client.

queries.query: Serve static files from a directory
queries.notes: send_from_directory serves a file under a dir.

queries.query: Build a URL for a named endpoint
queries.notes: url_for builds a URL given endpoint + values.

queries.query: Flash message helpers
queries.notes: get_flashed_messages reads / clears flashes.

queries.query: Register a blueprint on an app
queries.notes: App.register_blueprint adds a blueprint. Blueprint.register_blueprint (nested blueprint) also acceptable.

queries.query: Class-based view base class
queries.notes: View is the base class for class-based views.

queries.query: Method-based class view that dispatches by HTTP method
queries.notes: MethodView dispatches get/post/put/delete to methods.

queries.query: Signal fired when a request starts
queries.notes: signals.py defines request_started / request_finished etc.

queries.query: Stream a response incrementally
queries.notes: stream_with_context wraps a generator so it has the request ctx.

queries.query: Set up the Jinja templating environment
queries.notes: Environment subclass that knows about Flask app config.

queries.query: Decorator to run code before every request
queries.notes: Scaffold.before_request is defined on the Scaffold class.
